results.name: Rule-based score (FR-06, baseline)
results.description: The existing match score of FR-06 and FR-15, scaled to 0..1.

results.name: Logistic Regression
results.description: Linear model on standardised features; fast and easy to explain.

results.name: Random Forest
results.description: 120 decision trees voting together; captures thresholds and interactions.

results.name: Multilayer Perceptron
results.description: Feed-forward neural network: 8 inputs, hidden layers of 32 and 16 neurons with dropout.

results.name: Wide & Deep Network
results.description: Wide part: a linear layer over the features and 3 crossed features (memorises simple rules); deep part: a 64-32-16 network (learns patterns). Their outputs are added.

results.name: Quantum Kernel SVM
results.description: Support vector machine whose kernel is the overlap of 4-qubit quantum states from a ZZ feature map, computed on Qiskit's statevector simulator. The encoding bandwidth and the number of feature-map repetitions are chosen by 5-fold cross-validation on the training rows.

results.name: Variational Quantum Classifier
results.description: 4-qubit circuit: a ZZ feature map encodes the data and a RealAmplitudes circuit with 12 trainable rotation angles classifies it; the angles are tuned by COBYLA to minimise cross-entropy. Probabilities come from Qiskit's exact statevector simulator. The encoding bandwidth is the one chosen by the kernel model's cross-validation (training a VQC takes about 2 minutes, too slow to cross-validate each setting).
